### About me, professionally

[LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/kara-joyce-leier)<br>

I hold three degrees: Master of Data Science (Computational Linguistics), B.A. Honours in Linguistics, and B.Sc. 3 year in Computer Science.  \
In my undergraduate honours thesis I worked with a low-resource language, Dëne Sųłıné, comparing computational and manual methods for assigning semantic meaning to words. \
In my masters, I continued to learn about what to do with minimal or sparse data, focusing on LLMs, but also how to be authentic and preserve language in the use of LLMs. \
From there, I began working as a Research Analyst at VIDO in Saskatoon, SK. 
At VIDO, I apply my computational linguistic expertise to answer questions and guide research in immunology. Stay tuned :)

**Current position**: Research Analyst @ VIDO \
Research interests: computational linguistics, interdisciplinary approaches to problems, low-resource research
